title: Validated original-source interval at V=2, d=18 unconditional row
question: Can the exact finite R-419 oscillator/Hamiltonian source be enclosed at the separately fixed cutoff d=18, propagated through the normalized unconditional one-site Gibbs row and a preregistered core/tail residual compression, with a positive finite interval gap?

selection_contract.rule: Use the first preregistered source row in the beta=8, right-orientation enumeration whose emission ordinal is zero; select before interval evaluation and never from the resulting gap.

interval_contract.arithmetic: Reuse the validated directed mpmath.iv source and propagation primitives with midpoint/radius bounds for the d=18 finite matrices.

assumptions: The hash-pinned R-419 rational oscillator fixture is unchanged and is the exact finite source at V=2,d=18.
Exchange and global Fock-parity symmetries commute with the finite source Hamiltonian, so the four declared blocks preserve its finite spectrum.
The R-433 polar-correction and Gibbs-kernel perturbation inequalities remain valid after the d=18 residual and Gram checks.
The unconditional row is the normalized one-site marginal of the finite Gibbs diagonal, and the fixed tail threshold is four.
The interval Cholesky and Rayleigh certificates use the same symmetric compressed residual enclosure.
missing_assumptions: A cutoff-, volume-, phase- and exhaustion-uniform interval estimate.
A common unbounded Q3 core, history transfer and OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction.
Residual-reuse closure against the R-422/R-426 route and a common limit-order theorem.
Physical-sector admission, an absolute physical reference and any Yang-Mills interpretation.
stop_conditions: If any d=18 block, source residual, Gram bound, normalized row or fixed split fails, retain the probe as inconclusive and do not promote.
If the interval crosses the tail threshold or any fixed probe, report the exact interval and do not call the row certified.
If a hostile mutation is accepted, fail the integrated verifier instead of relaxing the contract.
Never promote this finite row certificate to a common-core, physical, Yang-Mills or mass-gap theorem.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED VALIDATED FINITE ORIGINAL-SOURCE INTERVAL AT d=18; NO UNIFORM OR PHYSICAL PROMOTION
non_claims: No cutoff/volume/phase/exhaustion-uniform Schur or Poincare theorem.
No common core, history transfer, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, sector gap or continuum limit.
No physical-empty energy sign, Reading-H stationarity or symmetry-projected transverse stability.
No C6, Sector-A, Pre-A, Yang-Mills or mass-gap conclusion.

lean_crosscheck.role: Lean checks the declared d=18 block arithmetic, fixed probe ordering, row split cardinalities and finite/no-promotion scope; interval matrix operations remain executable Python.

boundary: One finite V=2,d=18,beta=8 unconditional one-site marginal row. The certificate is an auxiliary source-interval datapoint; all uniform, physical-empty and Yang-Mills/mass-gap flags remain false.
